Bill.BriefDescription: Giving counties the authority to establish community protection zones.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to community protection zones; and adding a newsection to chapter 9.94A RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 9.94A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A county may establish a community protection zone, as definedunder RCW 9.94A.030 for an offender convicted of a sex offense. (2) A county may enact a rule or ordinance prohibiting an offenderconvicted of a sex offense from residing near a public or privateschool, playground, public swimming pool, day care center, organizedcampground, community center, and any other facility whose primarypurpose is the education or care of persons under eighteen years ofage. (3) Any county may enact such a rule or ordinance, or may designatespecific areas where an offender convicted of a sex offense may reside.
